headline: Microsoft Revenue Reaches $92.3 Billion as Azure Cloud Unit Grows 48%
summary: Microsoft generated $92.3 billion in quarterly revenue and $36.6 billion in profit, exceeding Wall Street estimates. Growth was propelled by a 48% expansion in its Azure cloud division, following voluntary buyout offers to 60,000 workers.
why: Microsoft is a leading global technology company whose cloud and software infrastructure power global corporate IT spending.

impacts.name: Microsoft
impacts.why: Better-than-expected revenue and strong Azure cloud expansion boost valuation.

why_moved: Earnings and cloud growth topping consensus projections boost investor confidence in enterprise tech demand.
